quest.minecraft:bookshelf.title: &eBookshelf
quest.minecraft:bookshelf.quest_subtitle: The starting block of every enchanting room.
quest.minecraft:bookshelf.quest_desc: &7The &eBookshelf&7 is the cornerstone of any enchanting setup.

&7Each one placed within range of the &bEnchanting Table&7 contributes &b+1 Eterna&7 (max enchant level) and &b+0.75 Quanta&7. In Apothic Enchanting you can stack far more shelves than vanilla allows.
&eTip:&r Place 15 bookshelves in a 5×5 ring around the table to reach base Eterna 50.
quest.minecraft:trident.title: &bTrident
quest.minecraft:trident.quest_subtitle: A worthy test for your enchanting power.
quest.minecraft:trident.quest_desc: &7The &bTrident&7 is one of the most rewarding weapons to enchant in Apothic Enchanting.
&7With high enough &dArcana&7, you can roll &9Loyalty III&7, &bRiptide III&7, &eChanneling&7 and &cImpaling V&7 — plus rare Apoth-only enchants like &dCapturing&7 or &dKnowledge&7.
&eTip:&r Drowned with tridents are rare — try fishing during thunderstorms for a faster route.
quest.apothic_enchanting:endshelf.title: &dEndshelf
quest.apothic_enchanting:endshelf.quest_: &7The &dEndshelf&7 is a specialized bookshelf crafted from &dPurpur&7 and &dEnder Pearls&7.
&7Each one grants &b+2 Eterna&7 and a strong &d+5 Arcana&7 boost — making rare endgame enchants far more likely to appear in the table's offer list.
&eTip:&r Mix Endshelves with &cHellshelves&7 to balance Eterna, Quanta and Arcana.
Unlock loot-only enchantments at the table.
&7The &6Treasure Shelf&7 is the rarest shelf in Apothic Enchanting.
&7It allows your &bEnchanting Table&7 to offer normally &6treasure-only&7 enchantments such as &dMending&7, &dFrost Walker&7, &dSoul Speed&7 and &dSwift Sneak&7 directly.
&eTip:&r Combine 4+ Treasure Shelves with high Arcana to roll endgame books without trading with villagers.
